name: Atelier
concept: A quiet art-gallery atelier: taupe walls, black type in a refined grotesk, one chocolate accent and generous white space; every face treated like a portrait.
signature: hero as a gallery wall: three framed images of different sizes with museum-style captions
headline split over two lines with the second line indented to form a step
treatments listed like an exhibition index with numbers and short captions
imagery: black-and-white and muted-colour portraits of texture, flowers and the studio; framed with white mats and captions
why: Matches her 'every face treated with intention' promise with a calm, artful feel.
